[Paper • 2610.18472 • Published  •  31](/papers/2610.18472) 

# 
		
	
	
		SMD

## 
		
	
	
		Simplifying and Improving On-Policy Distillation for Few-Step Diffusion

SMD is a simple and scalable method for few-step diffusion distillation across image, video, audio-video and 3D generation.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18472) · [Project page](https://zjwfufu.github.io/SMD-Page/) · [Code](https://github.com/zjwfufu/SMD) · [Models](https://huggingface.co/collections/zjwfufu/smd-6ac5f4b53c26548a75672189) · [Datasets](https://huggingface.co/collections/zjwfufu/smd-data-6ac91ac901f38f4c261ec8d4)

This page is the project overview. Follow the links below for the released weights, inference instructions, workflows, datasets and original examples.

## 
		
	
	
		Explore the model family

The groups below organize models by task. Each student retains its own architecture and base-model requirements; SMD is the shared distillation method.

| Task | Released models | Sampling steps | 
|---|---|---|
| Text to image | [FLUX.1-dev](https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-FLUX.1-dev) · [Qwen-Image](https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-Qwen-Image) · [SD3.5-Medium](https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-SD3.5-Medium) · [FLUX.2 Klein 4B](https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-FLUX.2-Klein-4B) · [Lens](https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-Lens) | 4 for the students | 
| Image editing | [Qwen-Image-Edit-2511](https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-Qwen-Image-Edit-2511) | 4 | 
| Text to video | [Wan2.1 1.3B](https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-Wan2.1-1.3B) · [Wan2.1 14B](https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-Wan2.1-14B) · [Causal Wan2.1 1.3B](https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-Wan2.1-1.3B-Causal) | 4 | 
| Text to audio-video | MiniMax H3 T2VA: [4-step](https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-MiniMax-H3-T2VA-4step) · [8-step](https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-MiniMax-H3-T2VA-8step) | 4 / 8 | 
| Reference to audio-video | MiniMax H3 Ref2VA: [4-step](https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-MiniMax-H3-Ref2VA-4step) · [8-step](https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-MiniMax-H3-Ref2VA-8step) | 4 / 8 | 
| Image to 3D | [Hunyuan3D-2.1 Shape](https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-Hunyuan3D-2.1-Shape) · [TRELLIS.2 Shape and Texture](https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-TRELLIS.2) | 4 per distilled stage | 

SD3.5 includes six variants: `self`, `clipscore`, `geneval`, `ocr`, `pickscore` and `multi`. FLUX.2 Klein 4B includes `teacher-4b` and `teacher-9b`; Lens includes `teacher-lens` and `teacher-flux2-9b`, plus the original Lens base. TRELLIS.2 keeps separate shape and texture adapters in one repository.

### 
		
	
	
		H3 in ComfyUI

Native ComfyUI releases provide setup instructions and ready-to-use workflows:

| Task | 4 steps | 8 steps | 
|---|---|---|
| T2VA | [ComfyUI package](https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-MiniMax-H3-T2VA-4step-ComfyUI) | [ComfyUI package](https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-MiniMax-H3-T2VA-8step-ComfyUI) | 
| Ref2VA | [ComfyUI package](https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-MiniMax-H3-Ref2VA-4step-ComfyUI) | [ComfyUI package](https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-MiniMax-H3-Ref2VA-8step-ComfyUI) | 

## 
		
	
	
		Datasets and resources

| Repository | Contents | 
|---|---|
| [H3 T2VA 100K](https://huggingface.co/datasets/zjwfufu/SMD-H3-T2VA-100K) | 100,000 cached text-to-audio-video conditions | 
| [H3 Ref2VA 20K](https://huggingface.co/datasets/zjwfufu/SMD-H3-Ref2VA-20K) | 20,000 reference-to-audio-video training instructions and their cached conditions | 
| [Categorized Prompts 150K](https://huggingface.co/datasets/zjwfufu/SMD-Categorized-Prompts-150K) | Categorized training prompts | 
| [Prompt Sample Resources](https://huggingface.co/datasets/zjwfufu/SMD-Prompt-Sample-Resources) | Fixed sampling inputs, cached conditions and preview resources | 

## 
		
	
	
		Get started

1. Choose a model for your task from the table above.
2. Open its repository and follow the standalone inference or ComfyUI instructions.
3. Use its provided example case and sampling settings, then adapt the inputs for your own task.

LoRA releases require the matching base model. Follow each package's pinned base revision and sampling settings. For training and export, use the [SMD code repository](https://github.com/zjwfufu/SMD).

## 
		
	
	
		Examples

Each model repository includes worked examples with original outputs and generation settings. Explore the [image and video examples](https://huggingface.co/collections/zjwfufu/smd-6ac5f4b53c26548a75672189), [Hunyuan3D mesh example](https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-Hunyuan3D-2.1-Shape#example), and [TRELLIS.2 geometry and textured turntables](https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-TRELLIS.2#example).
